recipes.name: Strawberry Whipped Sensation
ingredients_raw: 1 (14 ounce) can Eagle Brand® Sweetened Condensed Milk
1 (8 ounce) tub COOL WHIP Whipped Topping, thawed, divided
8 OREO Chocolate Sandwich Cookies, finely chopped

steps.text: Line a 9x5-inch loaf pan with foil with the ends of foil extending over the sides of the pan.
Mash 2 cups strawberries in a large bowl. Add condensed milk, lemon juice, and 2 cups whipped topping; mix well. Pour into prepared pan.
Mix chopped cookies and butter. Spoon over whipped topping mixture. Cover with ends of foil and gently press cookie mixture into whipped topping mixture. Freeze for 6 hours, or until firm.
Invert dessert onto a serving plate when ready to serve; remove pan and foil. Spread remaining whipped topping onto top and sides of dessert.
Slice remaining 2 cups strawberries; arrange over dessert. Store leftovers in the freezer.

raw_recipe.headline: Strawberry Whipped Sensation
raw_recipe.description: Fresh strawberries and Cool Whip make a creamy mixture on a chocolate cookie base — topped with more strawberries — for a beautiful frozen dessert.

review.reviewBody: I have made this a few times, and it tastes 10 times better if you let it almost totally defrost before serving. (I let it sit out at least 1/2 hour after removing from loaf pan). If you serve right out of the freezer, it is kind of tasteless, but is delicious when it melts a little. Also, I made the mistake of using a store brand once, but real Cool Whip tastes much better. Other points I discovered after reading reviews and also making a few times: Get 12 oz. Cool Whip to have enough to use in the recipe and to be able cover the entire loaf at serving time. I use 10 oreos plus 1 1/2 tbsp. butter for a more substantial crust. This keeps well in the freezer. You can make it a couple of weeks in advance so there's one less thing to do when preparing for company. All in all, it's a good summer dessert.
Very good! I made it for a dinner party of 8 and there was plenty. Definitely freeze longer than 6 hours. Overnight would be better. I also doubled the oreos for a thicker crust.

I recently saw this recipe and made it today. Delicious! I took another member's advice and added a layer of crushed oreos, and used a 1/2 tablespoon extra of butter for the bottom oreo crust layer. I used cool whip for the inside filling, but made my own whipped cream for the topping. It came out awesome!!
Refreshing summer dessert. I pressed the oreos and butter into a crust on the bottom of a pie plate.

This was delicious. I used a store bought chocolate cookie crust and poured the filling into it. There was a lot and it was quite soupy and did not fit in the pie crust. So I let it freeze for a while and then spooned more filling on top so that it could hold about 95% of the filling. (The rest of the filling was the cook's treat!). After it was frozen, I spread the rest of the Cool Whip over the top. I was quite surprised but one 8 ounce container of whipped cream is actually enough to make this dessert. My 10 year old grand daughter is already asking me to make it for her again!

This was a hit the first time I made it so now I make two of them because its the most requested dessert! Great for summer socials! To make it easier to prepare, pour into a ready made Oreo pie crust and freeze. I put fresh sliced strawberries on top before serving. It's better to thaw 30 min on the counter prior to serving.

I'd give this 4.5 stars. I mashed the strawberries with my (clean!) hands until they were very squishy. I used 1/4 cup of key lime juice (all I had). I tasted it in the bowl, it was sweet, tasted like strawberries with some key lime juice (probably could have used 1/2 cup of the key lime if I had it). I figured that since we weren't baking it, the flavor would not change much, only absorb slightly more. I used 2 C. real whipped cream slightly sweetened with sugar/vanilla. This made it pretty sweet. I think next time I'd skip the sugar and just add vanilla. I used 12 oreos + 1 1/2 tbs butter. When you taste it out of the freezer, it tastes like ice crystal ice cream. Definitely let it thaw. I wish I would have used 20 oreos for the crust, would have been better. I'd also leave out the butter or reduce to 1/2 tbs. I could feel the grease on my tongue after I had a bite. Oreos have the inside portion which is creamy enough, so if they're mixed well I don't think there would be a need for butter. Next time I will use double stuffed.

Delicious! I used frozen strawberries and thawed then mashed them. Used homemade whipper cream and real vanilla extract. It took mine way longer than four hours to freeze. My family liked this better when it wasn't frozen all the way and more like mousse. I would like to try making this in an Oreo® pie crust. Filling it with the strawberry mousse then maybe adding a later of whipper cream to the top with strawberries to decorate! This was delicious and I highly recommend it!
I have made this with Blueberries, Raspberries, and Kiwi. so delish. Changed up the crust with sugar cookies.

This was amazing, and so refreshing on a hot day! I used Oreo cookie crumbs instead, and layered strawberry mix, cookie crumbs and then some sliced strawberries and put mix over top with more cookie crumbs. I also didn't have lemon juice on hand so I used some fruit flavoured wine. It turned out perfect! Next time I think I will experiment with some of the other readers suggestions with graham crumbs and kiwi. Thank you for sharing this :)

I used a food processor to mash the berries, and forgot to add the butter to the cookies, and it was really good, so if you want a lower fat content, emit the butter. If you make this cake, and your freezer is not very cold, maybe freeze longer than suggested. Tasted great though, and was still fancy looking, even though it was kind of flat and spread out looking. I would make it again, quick and easy, and oh, so yummy!
The only thing I changed was increase the cookies to 12.
This looks delicious and it was so fun making. We won’t try it until tomorrow of course but I know it will be dekicious. The reason I gave it a 4 star is in the ingredients it called for only 1 ounce
This was yummy. That sweetened condensed milk and strawberry mix is WOW! Delicious. My crust was much thinner than the picture but it still turned out good.
I took a shorter route and put it into a pre prepared cookie crust. Everyone still loved it!
I made this maybe a dozen times o r more. It's been a big hit every time.
So easy to make......great substitute for home-made ice cream cake. Substitute most fresh fruits for the strawberries and "pile on the Cool-Whip!!!

I've made this for years now! It is a great summer-time dessert with few ingredients and so fast to make. The only change I ever make is sometimes depending on what is in season I will mix other berries in too.
It is delicious, perfect for the summer! I used more than 8 cookies otherwise, the base was to thin.
Everytime I make this dessert it's always a hit! It's a keeper.
